usedFor: ikas runs the online store, and Freshsales Classic receives each sale as a deal through “New Order” and “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in ikas, then “Create Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A new order opens a deal with a stage and close date, creating the contact if missing.

watchOut: “Create Deal” links to an account, so each order needs an account in Freshsales Classic.
